name: Windows LM Hash Storage Disabled
description:
Ensures Windows does not store LAN Manager hashes of passwords (NoLMHash = 1). LM hashes can be cracked in minutes.
Required Windows permission (remedy only): LEA agent account must be allowed to run only: reg add HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Lsa /v NoLMHash (administrator rights) via a delegated run-as permission, Scheduled Task, or service configuration.

_remedy.command: reg add HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Lsa /v NoLMHash /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f | Out-Null; reg query HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Lsa /v NoLMHash
